_scenario: Buoy is unreachable - no AP in range, DNS/connect failure, or request timeout (AqOneConfig.buoyTimeout = 6s)

expected_client_behavior.ui_message: Not sent - no buoy nearby. Will send automatically.

_notes: There is no JSON body for this case - it is a transport-layer failure (SocketException/TimeoutException), not an HTTP error response.
Per docs/06_DELIVERY_STATES.md, delivery state must not advance past 'saved' when this happens; the record stays in the outbox for retry.
